Asset type: individual Bible Journey illustration of a parable, landscape 1536×1024, full frame, no interface or text.

A saddled pack animal waits quietly nearby. Show care and responsibility through natural gestures; no graphic wounds or distress.
Composition/framing: Wide three-quarter view. Keep the Samaritan, traveler, innkeeper, coins, and animal fully within the left 65%; reserve the right 30% as quiet stone wall and soft courtyard ground for a reading panel. Keep the top and bottom 12% free of essential subjects. One continuous scene, no collage or sequential panels.
Style/materials: Warm cinematic realistic historical illustration; worn woven garments, weathered stone, simple oil vessel and cloth, natural faces and hands, soft golden light, muted earth tones.
Constraints: The Samaritan is the helper in Jesus’ parable; the innkeeper receives two coins and the traveler has visible bandaging. Do not add a named route, signs, text, labels, pins, logos, border, watermark, modern objects, or invented backstory.
notes: Root inspected the full final raster and its named subjects. Hotspot coordinates were checked against the accepted image. Appearance and setting are illustrative; literary images are labeled in the reader.
